declaration: the PCL-003 evaluation's explicit outcome thresholds — DECLARED BEFORE THE RUN (the declared-before/verdict-after discipline; committed at the app-skeleton milestone, before any evaluation run produced a verdict). A threshold miss WITH honest attribution is a valid delivery; a silently lowered threshold is an automatic void.
basis: ACR-010 §5 (the evaluation contract — the program's evidence standard): per-failure-class percentiles, cost truth, resolution honesty, the promotion gate (never median alone), the honest replay of the PPR-027 latency cells under the typed-facts configuration

t1Tail.pool: successful-outcome end-to-end latency (the capstone's own latency-tail definition, quoted: "Successful-outcome end-to-end task latency over N resolved task(s)") — the resolution-honesty leg (t2) guards this pool against failure-hiding
t1Tail.statement: the tail-tuned arm's successful-outcome latency p95 AND p99 (over every replayed execution of the complete 102-cell sweep, typed facts only, synthetic-latency basis) are STRICTLY below the baseline-today arm's; the per-failure-class/route decomposition is disclosed on every line (never aggregate-only)

t2Resolution.statement: the tail-tuned arm's resolution rate is NOT below the baseline-today arm's (a tail improvement that costs resolution is a MISS, mechanically); verification outcomes per configuration disclosed

t3Cost.statement: the tail-tuned arm's TOTAL cost including duplicate attempts (synthetic-price-schedule basis) does not exceed the baseline-today arm's by more than the declared +25% budget delta; verification cost carried as its own line with its explicit basis

t4Preservation.statement: the PCL-002 preservation gate passes at construction (fail-closed), ZERO terminal failures masked (every failed-terminal outcome records resolved=false), ZERO dispatch-budget violations, and the attempt census reconciles EXACTLY on every cell of both arms (attempts = original + retry + fallback + verification — dropped or reclassified failures are an automatic void)

t5Reproducibility.statement: the complete evaluation re-run reproduces the evaluation digest byte-for-byte (wall-clock and run identities excluded from every digest projection)

honestyRules: every number this evaluation emits carries its synthetic basis (synthetic-supply, synthetic-cost, synthetic-latency) — no live/credentialed provider runs, no SLA or production-latency claims (operator-era obligation, never backfilled)
the capstone's recorded results are quoted VERBATIM (their own wall-clock basis preserved, never relabeled, never reused as evaluation inputs)
the promotion gate's verdict is DERIVED from these declarations against the measured aggregates, never asserted; median improvement alone promotes nothing
